title: CapabilityVectorCaseDirection
description: DD-124(3)(4): the direction of a whole V2 case. FORWARD cases are driven by the production Core probe execute. RECEIVER marks a case that depends on the service read edge (an ingest consuming a source through READ_EDGE, a NATIVE_MANAGED receiver key): every step of it runs in the isolated deployment of 07 §8A and the production plan only observes each step through receiver_start/receiver_observe; steps are never split between the directions.
